 Exercise Your Ride to Vote with VIA’s Complimentary Service on Election Day, November 3
 November 2, 2026 
 VIA Metropolitan Transit will offer complimentary service to polling locations for Election Day on Tuesday, November 3, 2026 .
 As part of its “Ride VIA to Vote” program, VIA will provide complimentary rides to and from the polls on Election Day across all services, including bus, VIA Link and VIAtrans.
 Passengers can ride without fare by presenting a valid voter registration card to the operator.
 The program is designed to remove transportation barriers and make it easier for residents to participate in the democratic process.
 Registered VIAtrans customers should schedule trips in advance according to standard policies. VIA Link service is available within designated zones, with connections to the broader VIA network.
 Customers can plan their trip using the GO VIA app . A full list of voting locations is available at elections.bexar.org .
